metadata.purpose: E-commerce category filtering - Type/Style recommendations for customer navigation
metadata.approach: One filter per category based on how customers search
metadata.hierarchy: Department → Category → Category Type/Style → [Detailed Spec Filters]
metadata.notes: Values map to existing Salesforce Style/Type picklist where possible. status='existing' means style_id exists in Salesforce, status='new_needed' means a new style needs to be created.

categories.logic: Sink + faucet bundles by installation type

categories.notes: Soaking, Whirlpool, Air Bath should be separate 'Tub Feature' filter
Bowl shape, height, flush type should be separate filters
Features like soft-close, heated should be separate filters
